name: videngineer
description: Break down any video scene by scene and plan your own from it.

interface.longDescription:
VidEngineer is a video research and pre-production tool. This plugin connects your existing VidEngineer workspace so you can study videos and plan your own in conversation instead of opening the app.

Break down a video
Paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo or X, or a direct video file. VidEngineer maps it scene by scene: every cut, the hook, the transcript, who is on screen, the voice, the music and the sound effects. A breakdown takes about a minute and a half. You can check on it while it runs and open the full report when it is done.

Plan your own video
Turn a breakdown into cut briefs and a cut list for your own product. Ask what makes a cut work and how to adapt its structure to your brand, your footage and your message.

Make your own version
Use a breakdown as the blueprint for your own video. Pull the full structure of a breakdown into the conversation and build your version from it: the script, the shot list and the prompts for each shot, made with your own product, footage and message.

Work on a canvas
Create a planning board, add frames, notes and references, and open boards you have already made. Boards are saved in your workspace, so your team sees the same plan in the app.

Find past work
List your breakdowns, assets and folders, and pick up where you left off.

How it works
VidEngineer runs every breakdown on its own servers and stores your breakdowns, cut briefs and canvases in your own VidEngineer workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Starting a breakdown fetches the video from the link you provide, and that tool is labelled as such. Deleting a board is labelled as destructive, and boards can be restored in the app. You sign in with your existing VidEngineer account over OAuth. Reading your library, starting breakdowns, writing cut briefs and editing canvases are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time.
